title: Playing for white strip shows and the proposed band screen
summary: At the Moulin Rouge he emceed striptease shows, and a woman tried to require screens in front of Black bands.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Yeah, we, we could, we could have been arrested when we were, uh, playing at that place on bourbon, at 1111 bourbon, I don't know, with Danny and Louise and, uh, and, uh, Albert Walters. Well, here they didn't bother you.
Yeah. Because when I worked at the Mullen Ruards, uh, I played and emceed the show for white striptease acts.
And I don't mean come down to the G-string, they came down to their birthday club.
And I remember one time, Miss Wurrlein tried to get them to pass a law that every nightclub had a show and had a black band that had to have a screen in front of the band.
